name: Kite Drift
description: A one-button glide. Hold to lift a kite, let go to sink, and drift through the wide gaps between soft cloud banks. A bump never ends the game.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A kite drifts right across a soft sky. Hold one button to lift it and release to let it sink gently.
help.goal: Fly through as many gaps between cloud banks as you can and build a long streak. There is no death screen.
howToPlay: Hold Space, the Up arrow or the big on-screen button to lift the kite.
Release to let it sink slowly. Speed is capped so it always stays gentle. Pace sets how fast the sky scrolls: slow, normal or brisk. You can change it at any time.
Steer through the wide gap in each cloud bank. Each gap you pass adds to your streak.
If you touch a cloud the kite is bumped to the middle of the gap and your streak starts over. Flying simply goes on.

controls.action: Start or resume after the Ready prompt
Reach the Hold to lift button, New flight and Pace

tips: Short taps give small lifts; holding gives steady climbs.
The next gap is never more than a gentle climb or sink away.
Reduced motion removes the moving background and the kite tilt.
